From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: HealthLynx — access & governance evidence request / next steps

Hi Alice / Rajesh — great speaking earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Call recap:
- Goal: confirm Redwood's identity & access controls and provide evidence so your procurement & security teams can complete the vendor review.
- Primary asks from HealthLynx: SSO/SAML integration details, SCIM provisioning info, RBAC/admin controls, and a short note on SOC 2 / HIPAA posture.

Requested artifacts (we can accept files or links):
1) SAML metadata + SP/IdP endpoints (XML or file export)
2) SCIM base endpoint, supported attributes, and a sample mapping (JSON or docs)
3) RBAC / admin role matrix (who can create service accounts, who has org-admin privileges, MFA enforcement) — I attached an access_matrix_template.xlsx to speed this up
4) Any questionnaire answers or documents your IT team expects us to fill — I attached a blank vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf

Notes on timeline: if you can provide the items above by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-26) we should be able to turn around a procurement package (NDA + redacted SOC 2) within two business days. If SOC 2 sharing requires an NDA on your side, let me know and I’ll route a one-way NDA via DocuSign.

Next steps:
- Alice/Rajesh: send SAML metadata and confirm if you prefer screenshots vs exports for any logs.
- HealthLynx: flag any fields in the questionnaire you want pre-filled.
- We’ll schedule a 30-min security deep-dive if needed (technical folks + infra lead).

Attachments: access_matrix_template.xlsx, vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@healthlynx.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthLynx — access & governance evidence request / next steps

Thanks Ben — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2 / HIPAA: our procurement team requires either a current SOC 2 Type II report or a signed letter confirming scope and date. Do you have a public SOC 2 summary page we can link to? Will you be able to share a redacted report after an NDA?
- Evidence format: for the RBAC matrix, would a spreadsheet be best (we can use your template). For SCIM, do you need live endpoints or is a sample mapping sufficient for initial review?
- Logs: for admin audit logs, our security team prefers exported CSVs rather than screenshots. If exports are not available, we’ll take the best alternative you can provide.

We’ll aim to gather the initial items on our side by Wednesday. Attaching our security team contact vcard — Rajesh will coordinate internally. Also please include any compliance contact at Redwood who can speak to onboarding and SOC 2 handoff.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alice Monroe
Head of IT Security, HealthLynx
alice.monroe@healthlynx.com | +1 (650) 555-0133
Attachment: security_team_contact.vcf

Alice — thanks, quick answers below and next steps.

SOC 2 / HIPAA status:
- Redwood Inference completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in Q4 2026. We also maintain documented HIPAA controls for covered workloads and support a BAA where required.
- We can share a redacted SOC 2 report after a one-way NDA; if needed we can also provide a SOC 2 summary page (public) for initial procurement evaluation: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-report (link above).

Evidence format and exports:
- RBAC matrix: spreadsheet works great — please use the attached template.
- SCIM: for initial review we typically provide a JSON sample mapping and documentation. Live endpoints are optional for the first pass; we can provide a short test account if you want to validate.
- Admin audit logs: we can export CSVs for admin events (account create/delete, role changes, permission grants) — we’ll pull a small sample export for you.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) I’ll route the one-way NDA (DocuSign) for SOC 2 sharing unless you tell me otherwise.
2) Our security lead (Rishi) can join a 30-min technical deep-dive to walk through SAML / SCIM specifics. Rishi, can you be available Friday 2027-05-28 morning PT?
3) HealthLynx to send any pre-filled questionnaire fields and the SAML metadata file when available.

If that works, I’ll schedule the NDA + security call.

Best,
Ben
